citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: The paper completes the sentence: Bāysunghur commissioned two of Ibn Turka's most important imperial lettrist treatises, and his renown as a calligrapher is tied to Ibn Turka's valorisation of men of hand and sight (Q 38:45); Ibn Turka's praise of men of minds explicitly celebrates Ulugh Beg's mathematical labours. The treatises are not named on this page.
